subject: Staged Procurement & MAP: BlueWave Labs AWS Private Offer
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@bluewave.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Kim <timothy.kim@bluewavelabs.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff — AWS private offer interest

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — BlueWave Labs is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed on chat-heavy workloads. We have two procurement asks up front before we can move to an internal PO: a) a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and expected deliverables during evaluation + procurement; and b) confirmation of the billing path for an AWS Private Offer (we need to know whether Redwood will invoice us directly, or whether this will be handled via AWS consolidated billing / marketplace private offer flow).

Our timeline is tight: evaluation by the end of August, procurement sign-off first half of September, then production in Q4. Can you share a one-page MAP we can attach to our procurement packet, plus any sample Private Offer docs or billing instructions you normally use? Also, our security team will want a short checklist for SOC 2 + data handling during the eval.

Attached: BlueWave procurement kickoff (procurement contact: Timothy Kim).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — can we target a MAP draft by Tuesday, Jul 27?

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Procurement Lead, BlueWave Labs
Attachments: bluewave_procurement_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 340 KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Timothy Kim <timothy.kim@bluewavelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — AWS private offer interest

Hi Maria / Tim,

Thanks — glad the demo landed. Attached is a first-draft MAP (bluewave_map_v1.pdf) and a short note on the billing options we can support. High level: we can do either (1) AWS Private Offer (Marketplace flow) where BlueWave accepts charges through AWS and Redwood invoices via the Private Offer link, or (2) Redwood invoices BlueWave directly (net-30 invoice) while we set up the Private Offer in parallel for consolidated billing. Both are common; the Private Offer flow is usually preferred for procurement traceability.

Draft MAP highlights (short version):
- Week 0 (Jul 26–Aug 1): Eval environment provisioned (Redwood provides sandbox credentials + sample prompt set) — owner: Redwood (Jonas)
- Week 1–2 (Aug 2–15): Integration & run tests (BlueWave engineering + Redwood support) — owners: BlueWave eng / Grace O'Connor
- Week 3 (Aug 16–22): Security review + SOC 2 evidence exchange — owner: BlueWave security / Redwood security (laura_bennett)
- Week 4 (Aug 23–29): Contract redlines + PO issuance — owners: BlueWave procurement / Redwood sales (Ben Carter)
- Target close (PO signed): by Sep 10; production cutover: early Oct (contingent on PO and Private Offer setup)

Attachments: bluewave_map_v1.pdf, redwood_aws_private_offer_2027-07-30.pdf (sample private offer copy). I also included a short checklist for what we typically need for marketplace private offers (billing contacts, AWS account IDs, finance PO number, tax forms).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the preferred billing path (Private Offer vs Redwood invoice).
2) Share any contract redline windows — if your legal needs 5 business days, we'll schedule accordingly.
3) If acceptable, I can run a 30-min call Wed Jul 28 to walk the MAP with both procurement and security.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Attachments: bluewave_map_v1.pdf (PDF, 85 KB); redwood_aws_private_offer_2027-07-30.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@bluewave.ai>

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — AWS private offer interest

Jonas — thanks for the quick turn. The MAP looks reasonable; a few clarifying notes from procurement/security attached. We prefer the AWS Private Offer flow (Marketplace) for billing — BlueWave requires marketplace traceability and needs charges to flow via AWS. Our procurement team will still require Redwood to sign a short commercial addendum.

Highlights from our side:
- Security: will request the SOC 2 report and a short data handling questionnaire during Week 3.
- Billing: provide the Private Offer link and the marketplace SKU mapping; BlueWave's AWS account ID is 1111-2222-3333.
- Contract: legal will push a single redline pass week of Aug 23 — can Redwood provide a clean copy of the SOW for redline?

We can do the Wed Jul 28 10:00 PT call — Tim and I will be on.

Thanks,
Maria
Procurement Lead, BlueWave Labs
Attachments: bluewave_procurement_questionnaire.pdf (updated; PDF, 360 KB)
